title: Pre-restart qualification: three cases, ten attempts each

cases.title: Accident or construction blocking normal path
Unprotected left turn across dense traffic

notes: semanticYield counts attempts whose contract decision has semanticAccepted true, over attempts that reached a decision. Operational failures are never a semantic verdict and stay out of the denominator; they are gated separately by maxOperationalFailures.

Attempt evidence authority follows the pipeline: 75-product.json is the deliverable decision, 62-semantic2d.json is the semantic source evidence it quotes, and 95-benchmark.json supplies the stage and funnel facts.
crossing-VRU keeps the qualification-facing name while breadthCaseId names the lowercase campaign slug that a runner submits.
The exit evaluator refuses to run against calibration produced from a different gold manifest, a superseded review contract hash, or a different repetition count.
